evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate that frozen policy once on held-out test data.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: On a public 47,837-ticket, eight-class corpus, we compare four trained non-LLM classifiers with four large language models under zero- and few-shot prompting.
